channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: 1,400 Yemenis flee to Djibouti within 24 hours
item.description: Yemeni refugees arrive in Obock, Djibouti, within 24 hours as Houthis tighten their grip on the Bab al-Mandeb strait.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis seize strategic Mayun Island in Red Sea
item.description: Yemen’s Houthis have seized the strategic Mayun Island as they cement control over the Bab al-Mandeb Strait.

item.title: Iraq seizes drone-launching platform used for targeting Saudi oil pipeline
item.description: Saudi authorities trace the launch site to Maysan province in southeastern Iraq, near the Iranian border.

item.title: Iran’s Pezeshkian: ‘We are not at war with Saudi Arabia’
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Tehran is not at war with Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Houthi projectile wounds two, damages mosque in Jazan region, Saudi says
item.description: The Houthis say they carried out a strike targeting a Saudi military base in Sharurah, Najran province.

item.title: Iran war live: Tens of thousands displaced as Yemen fighting escalates
item.description: Houthi forces and Yemen's internationally recognised government trade strikes as fighting intensifies.

item.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
item.description: Iraq removes a military commander and opens investigations into the attack that came from an area bordering Iran.

item.title: Grammy-winning US rapper Lil Durk acquitted in murder-for-hire trial
item.description: The Chicago rapper was arrested in 2024 and accused of involvement in a shooting that killed the cousin of rival rapper Quando Rondo.

item.title: Lightning Houthi advance in Yemen may bring dangerous new dimension to Iran war
item.description: The capture by the rebels of a stretch of Yemen's strategic coastline is the group's most impressive military coup for several years.

item.title: When an avalanche killed climber Nirmal Purja, his friends faced the hardest mission of all
item.description: Mountaineer Mingma G tells the BBC about the climb to bring home the bodies of his closest friends.
